From February through April 1861, the United States and the Confederacy eye each other warily and vie for the support of eight slave states; as various compromise proposals fall short, Fort Sumter in Charleston Harbor becomes a flashpoint.
Many think that the South is fated to lose; learning when the Confederate States of America came closest to winning; as fighting begins, each side has important advantages.
Learning whether the Confederacy has better generals and which side has the edge in leadership.

Learning why the young men join the colors of the North or the South; understanding what makes them bear the war's awful dangers and hardships; uncovering what it is like to be a soldier in the ranks.
Both sides gear up for war; learning the details of General Winfield Scott's Anaconda Plan.
Exploring the significance of battlefields and the methods employed by soldiers in combat.
